items.source_excerpt: Gulf Cooperation Council Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Al-Budaiwi emphasized the urgent need for enhanced security cooperation between Gulf and Mediterranean countries to counter Iranian and Houthi threats, particularly concerning energy and maritime stability. Speaking at the Mediterranean Dialogues 2026 forum in Naples, he highlighted the interconnectedness of regional security and economic prosperity, advocating for a unified approach to address shared challenges and foster stronger trade and strategic ties.

items.title: Spanish PM Sanchez admits mistakes, defends record amid far-right surge before vote
items.source_excerpt: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez admitted to mistakes during a debate against conservative rival Alberto Nunez Feijoo ahead of the upcoming election, where the far-right Vox party is poised to gain power. The debate highlighted key issues such as the economy, housing crisis, and immigration, with Sanchez defending his record while facing criticism over rising living costs and corruption concerns.

items.title: Alibaba defrauded shareholders by concealing ties to suspected spy in Nvidia scandal, lawsuit says
items.source_excerpt: Alibaba has been sued by shareholders in New York for allegedly concealing ties to a suspected Chinese spy linked to the Nvidia scandal, which they claim inflated its share price. The lawsuit cites a significant drop in Alibaba's stock following revelations about its relationship with Megaspeed, a company implicated in helping China access advanced Nvidia technologies, and seeks unspecified damages for affected shareholders.
